description.text: The promos of the Diamond & Pearl Series, DP01 to DP56, released from May 2007 to December 2009: the first Black Star Promos with a prefix in their number. Nearly all came in products. Two- and three-pack blisters of each expansion carried the plainer cards, while collector's tins carried LV.X promos, from the Sinnoh first partners' final forms to Dialga, Palkia, Darkrai, Giratina, Shaymin and Arceus. Others came in value packs, premium boxes, poster packs and the Platinum Player's Guide, and the trophy card Tropical Wind went to players at the 2007, 2008 and 2009 World Championships. Two Trainer cards, Beginning Door and Ultimate Zone (DP54 and DP55), are known only in French.

description.text:
Tropical Wind returned as the promo card of the 2007 Pokémon World Championships, held from 10 to 12 August 2007 at the Hilton Waikoloa Village in Hawaii, keeping Sumiyoshi Kizuki's Psyduck artwork. Every competitor received the card in seven languages (English, Japanese, Spanish, Italian, German, French and Portuguese), each stamped "WORLDS 07", in a nine-pocket binder page.

The trophy versions carry a placement stamp, from Top Thirty-Two up to Finalist, and staff got a Staff copy. In all there were thirteen versions of the 2007 card.

tell.text: "FINALIST" printed below the card text, with the World Championships stamp on the picture: a prize for that placing.

description.text:
The last Tropical Wind, made for the 2009 Pokémon World Championships, held from 13 to 15 August 2009 at the Hilton San Diego Bayfront. Competitors received the card in seven languages, staff got a Staff copy, and the top finishers got copies stamped with their placement, from Top Thirty-Two up to Finalist.

Part of the print run carries the wrong number, DP25 (the 2008 card's number), instead of DP48. A collector on Elite Fourum reports that the error turns up on every version, the Finalist included.

A holofoil Beginning Door printed only in French, as Porte de départ. It reprints the Trainer card from the Arceus expansion with the promo number DP54. France never got the Arceus expansion, whose Arceus cards came there as a sub-set of Supreme Victors, which may be why DP54 and DP55 were made only in French. In Japan the card first came in Advent of Arceus. A promo copy with that set's logo on the art was a prize at Advent of Arceus release events in July 2009.
